# <span id="aanchor443"></span> TESTit 2 Integrated

TESTit integration into FLOWCAL provides a central repository for equipment calibration results and access to the TESTit Scheduler. This allows measurement office staff to oversee field operations and verify compliance.

Integrating the functionality of TESTit into FLOWCAL helps coordinate field operations and measurement office operations by making test reports available to office personnel and providing additional methods for validating test reports. It also allows for test reports to be edited at the office, includes a complete audit trail of field-entered data, and allows reports to be scheduled and distributed as needed.
